what_this_is: Contracts that used to stand in this collection and were taken down because they could not be reproduced at the current transform fingerprint. A frozen contract is a claim that a regression may be compared against; one measured against a transform that no longer exists is not. The numbers each carried are recorded here as what they now are -- a record of what used to be claimed, not evidence about the material.
